title: Nine Minutes and Eleven People
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：author　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 author 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 an ① author came to the library and read for nine minutes to eleven people, and my mother said that was a good crowd. The ② author, meaning the man and not the book, was nervous and had signed nine copies for nobody; an author, she said, is somebody who has finished a thing and now has to talk about it. She said the talking is the part nobody warns you about.

Every ③ author my father had met wanted to be asked about the writing and was asked about the money. Their ④ author — the one who came in March — had written nine books and remembered two of them; an author, my mother said, is the only worker who is praised for the part that was lonely. He said the lonely part is nine-tenths of it.

My grandfather said the ⑤ author of the whole trouble was the weather, and my grandmother said that was the truest use of the word. The ⑥ author, meaning the cause and not the writer, is the only word that covers both a book and a disaster; an author, she said, is either a person who made something or a thing that made something happen. She said the weather does both.

By 1979 the ⑦ author had given nine interviews and said the same thing in each, which he said was the trick. The ⑧ author on the card in the drawer was somebody else, with the same name; an author, my father said, is either a person or a name on a spine, and readers mean the second. He said the spine is nine inches of the whole business.

The ⑨ author I remember is the one who read for nine minutes, who asked more questions than he answered. An ⑩ author, my mother said in 1984, is the only person who is introduced to a room and then ignored by it; every author, she said, is a talker who has spent years alone. She said the aloneness shows in the first eleven words.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 作者；作家（一个人）
B. n. 作者（指人本身，与书相对）
C. n. 作者（指读了九分钟、问得比答得多的那一位）
D. n. 创始人；起因（比喻义）
E. n. 起因；造成者（抽象）
F. n. 作者（泛指这类人）
G. n. 作者（指抽屉卡片上那一位）
H. n. 作者（抽象总称）

items.q: an author came to the library
The author, meaning the man and not the book
Every author my father had met
the author of the whole trouble
The author, meaning the cause and not the writer
the author had given nine interviews
The author on the card in the drawer
An author, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: author 意为“作者、作家”，1973 年有一位作家来到图书馆，向十一个人念了九分钟，母亲说那算是好场面了。
author 指“人本身”，与书相对，那位作家很紧张，为没有人签了九本书。
author 泛指“作家这类人”，父亲见过的每一位作家都想被问写作，结果被问的都是钱。
author 意为“作者、作家”，他们那位作家，也就是三月来的那一位，写过九本书，只记得其中两本。
author 为比喻义，意为“创始人、起因”，祖父说整场麻烦的肇事者是天气，祖母说那是这个词最真实的用法。
author 意为“起因、造成者（抽象）”，与写作者相对，它是唯一既指一本书又指一场灾祸的词。
author 意为“作者、作家”，到 1979 年那位作家接受了九次采访，每次说的都一样，他说这就是诀窍。
author 指抽屉卡片上那一位，那是另一个人，名字却一样。
author 指读了九分钟、问得比答得多的那一位，我记得的就是他。
author 为抽象总称，母亲说作家是唯一被介绍给一个房间、然后被这个房间忽略的人。
